preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string `s` consists only of lowercase English letters.
The length of the string `s` is between 1 and 200,000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= r_i <= len(s) for l_i, r_i in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two integers `l_i` and `r_i` such that 1 ≤ `l_i` ≤ `r_i` ≤ |s|.
The number of queries `q` is between 1 and 200,000 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly `q` lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[i].isdigit() for i in range(q) for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each line of the output is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == sum(lcp(s[l_i-1:r_i], s[l_i-1+k:r_i]) for k in range(r_i - l_i + 1)) for i in range(q) for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines()] for l_i, r_i in queries)
postconditions.description: For each query `(l_i, r_i)`, the output line is the Ж-function of the substring `s[l_i..r_i]` (1-based indexing), defined as the sum of the Z-function values for that substring. The Z-function value at position `k` (1-based) is the length of the longest common prefix between the substring and its suffix starting at `k`.
